shaped into knots, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220°C for 12 minutes, with mustard.Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp salt, 40g melted butter and 300ml warm water and knead 5 minutes.Rise 1 hour.Divide into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzel knots.Boil 2L water with 60g bicarb and dip each pretzel for 20 seconds.Lay on lined trays,
